portals.prompt: Enter the Parish of the First Wick

plaques.text:
THE OLD OUTSKIRTS

Before the kingdom banked its light, it lived here — rope and wax, fish and prayer, six families to a stair.

The city moved up the hill and the hill kept the houses. Mind the balconies; the timbers remember rain.

THE PARISH OF THE FIRST WICK

Here the first vigil candle was dipped, long before the basilica raised its rock.

The door is sealed until someone speaks the three graven words. One cooled with the chandlers' wax. One wound up the steeplejack's stair. One never left the burnt wharf-house hearth.

word_stones.line: Wound tight up the stair, the way a wick winds through the tallow.
Where the chandlers boiled the comb, the first word set as it cooled.
The fire that ate the roofbeams never once left this hearth.
